description: Whenever added-axiom consequence \(\vdash_S\) is strongly complete for a frame class \(\mathscr K\), \(\Gamma\models_{\mathscr K}A\) holds exactly when some finite \(D\subseteq\Gamma\) already satisfies \(D\models_{\mathscr K}A\). In particular this applies to KC on directed future cones and LC on linearly ordered future cones.
